prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one high resolution transparent character sprite sheet for Refugio, an original children's animal rescue game. Exactly SIX full-body adorable quirky expressive rescue kittens, each entirely inside its own equal grid cell, arranged EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows, no borders, no labels, transparent background. All the kittens occupy similar size with generous space around them so none touches another cell. Hand-painted dimensional 2D animated-film storybook style with soft fur detail, clear expressive shapes, warm sunlight, funny little poses and oversized paws. Top left: curious orange tabby with cream belly sitting head tilted. Top middle: playful cream kitten with brown ears play-bowing. Top right: sleepy fluffy pale gray kitten curled up with one eye peeking open. Bottom left: curious charcoal gray kitten standing with tail question mark. Bottom middle: comically grumpy dark brown tabby sitting arms close with one raised eyebrow. Bottom right: affectionate white kitten with orange patches rolling slightly and waving a paw. No glasses, no outfits, no words, no humans, no watermark. True alpha transparency. Highest available resolution, overall sheet 3:2 landscape, each cell square. Consistent scale, fully visible tails and ears within each cell.
